component.name: Link Control
component.summary: Control pan, tilt, zoom and AI framing on Insta360 Link webcams

description.p: Link Control drives Insta360 Link and Link 2 webcams on Linux, where the manufacturer ships no software of its own. It moves the motorised gimbal, sets zoom and focus, adjusts the image, and switches the camera's built-in framing modes.

ul.li: Pan, tilt and zoom the gimbal, with presets you can save and recall
AI subject tracking, and how tightly it frames you
Whiteboard, Overhead and DeskView framing modes
Brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, white balance and focus
Hand gesture control and microphone noise cancellation
An optional live preview, and a full command line interface

description.p: Standard controls use V4L2, and the camera's proprietary features use its UVC extension units. Access to the camera device is required for both.

This is unofficial software, developed independently. It is not affiliated with, authorised by, or endorsed by Arashi Vision Inc. Insta360 and Insta360 Link are trademarks of their respective owner and are used here only to describe compatible hardware.
